device_entry.name: CryoTel GT 低温制冷机
device_entry.description: Sunpower CryoTel GT 闭循环低温制冷机，用于实验室低温环境提供、样品冷却和温度维持。
device_entry.description_en: A Sunpower CryoTel GT closed-cycle cryocooler used in laboratories for low-temperature generation, sample cooling, and temperature maintenance.
